name: Adullam
overview: Adullam is identified in Scripture both as an ancient city of Canaan and as a geographical location near the Dead Sea. It is mentioned among fortified cities such as Jarmuth and Socoh, highlighting its significance in the territorial landscape of Israel (Joshua 15:35; 2 Chronicles 11:7; Nehemiah 11:30). Additionally, Adullam is associated with refuge and protection, notably as a cave where David sought shelter, reflecting God's provision in times of distress. The references to the king of Adullam (Joshua 12:15) and the inhabitants of the region (Genesis 38:1; Micah 1:15) further underscore its historical and prophetic importance within the biblical narrative.
